scope: Fixed official-reference probes and an aggregate-only public branch-directory preflight; not a production data release

reference_probes.edition: 07/2019, confirmed from complete one-page guide text; not current assignment validity
Page updated 2025-04-08; portal-wide guidance, not a particular dataset release

branch_probe.semantics: One displayed post-office/branch row with optional street-number search hints, not a postal polygon or official civic-address/building link.
branch_probe.identity_policy: Postcodes may repeat across branches. Presentation ids are checked within this response only; sequential row indexes are not established stable provider object identifiers.
branch_probe.address_policy: An office address is not the civic address of every point sharing its postcode. Street-number strings are not parsed into individual premises, cadastral identifiers or building links.
branch_probe.coordinate_policy: Missing strings stay missing, never zero. Numeric range checks do not establish CRS, position accuracy, postal membership or boundary geometry.
branch_probe.date_policy: HTTP last-modified, page copyright year, retrieval time and response hashes are not a provider-declared assignment edition or validity interval.

rights_review.postal: Public operator guidance and an embedded office directory were observed. No explicit permission for retained source snapshots or transformed public artifacts was established. A public search page and its privacy policy are not a dataset reuse grant.
rights_review.public_address_fields: Official address-register guidance identifies public territorial/transport names and their history, property type and number. This is a positive public-access basis, not proof that a current bulk export with exact retention/transformation/redistribution terms has been obtained.
rights_review.protected_fields: The register also contains owner information, which is not in the reviewed public-field enumeration. Owner, occupant, recipient, title and protected registry fields remain excluded.
rights_review.cadastre: The reviewed cadastral article explains a registration/measurement service and its service fee; it is not a blanket statement that all address data or all public geometry is paid.
rights_review.open_data: The live non-www IDDA portal describes reusable open data with exclusions. A reviewed exact postal/address dataset, publisher, licence, edition and artifact are still required; portal availability or postal statistics alone do not supply assignment geometry.
rights_review.no_blanket_restriction_claim: This bounded review does not establish that all Azerbaijani public address or geographic data is unavailable or prohibited.
authority_gates: No new account, paid order, contract acceptance, protected registry query, public data destination, repository or production deployment without explicit approval.

authority_boundaries.postal: UPU syntax and a branch code do not establish current country-wide postcode allocation, a deliverability guarantee or official postal geometry.
authority_boundaries.address: Operator branch addresses and street-number search hints do not replace independently sourced official civic-address object identities.
authority_boundaries.building: Exact building display requires an independently permitted official address/cadastral identifier or reviewed explicit crosswalk; no nearest-building inference.
authority_boundaries.geometry: No official nationwide postal polygons were established in this review; derived, virtual and none remain distinct. No geometry is generated by this preflight.
authority_boundaries.territory: Preserve source jurisdiction and validity; do not infer sovereignty, alter country identity or bridge Nakhchivan and cross-border gaps.
